NOTICE TO ALL MEMBERS

Work Day — Saturday, 14 November 2026

The committee has scheduled a work day for this Saturday, 14 November. Please plan to attend.

Schedule
- 10:00 — Tool sharpener arrives (booked by Nell Okonjo)
- Throughout the day — General maintenance and winter preparation
- Water shut-off — Wren Castellan will shut off the water for the winter on the work day itself

What to bring
- Work gloves and sturdy footwear
- Any personal tools you prefer to use
- Water and snacks

Reminder
The winter closing checklist was circulated last week. Please send any comments to Tessa Varga by 10 November.

We rely on member participation to keep the property in good order. If you cannot attend, please let a committee member know in advance.

Committee
Tessa Varga, Ibrahim Solheim, Nell Okonjo, Paolo Drummond, Wren Castellan
